_comment: Template for the Local Network Portal (portal.html).
Copy this file to your OWN config directory, not into the installed
or any path you set in AGENTIC_HARNESS_PORTAL_SERVICES). Then replace
every placeholder host, port, and path with your real deployment values
and chmod 600 the result. Keeping it outside the package means real
hostnames cannot reach version control, cannot be captured by a local
wheel build, and are served only over the authenticated API.
Every host below uses the reserved example.invalid domain and every port
is arbitrary; nothing here is a default of anything.
Schema: the top level is {"services": [entry, ...]}. Each entry is an
object with a required non-empty "label" (string), a required "url"
(string, must be an http:// or https:// URL), and an optional "note"
(string). Entries whose url embeds a username or password, or carries a
credential-shaped query parameter (token, access_token, sig, signature,
password, secret, credential, api_key, key, auth), are refused. Skipped
entries are reported on the page. Unknown keys are ignored, including
this _comment key, which is documentation only.

services.label: Host root
services.note: Whatever you serve at the root of this machine (for many setups, a model-management panel).

services.label: Hub
services.note: Example of a service mounted behind a reverse-proxy path prefix at /hub/.

services.label: Cluster
services.note: Example of a second reverse-proxy path mount at /cluster/.

services.label: Agentic Harness GUI
services.note: This app, if you expose it on its own port. The port here is a placeholder; use whatever you pass to agentic-harness-gui --port.

services.label: Utility services
services.note: Example of a small utility service exposed on its own port (the port is a placeholder).

services.label: Agent Society
services.note: Example of a service running on a second machine on the same private network.

services.label: Local Studio
services.note: Point this at your local model studio panel, wherever you serve it.
